Billy Edwards Jr. Leads UNC to Victory Over No. 25 Pitt

Billy Edwards Jr. played a key role in the University of North Carolina's (UNC) 21-17 victory over No. 25 Pittsburgh (Pitt). This win marked the first time coach Belichick achieved a victory against a ranked opponent.
